counts.duplicate_rows: sum(max(0, receipt.rows - receipt.rows_new)) for captured receipts
counts.late_receipt_slot: a receipt slot following an inter-attempt gap greater than 1.5 declared cadences
counts.revised_event: same source, datastream and phenomenon/effective time with more than one distinct result, unit, quality or result-time signature

limits: A successful receipt proves reception, not a valid measurement.
Missing slots remain missing; no interpolation is used to reach a threshold.
A source-level receipt gate cannot qualify a thin series bucket; both gates must pass.
A series below the serious-baseline gate may remain visible as short history but cannot support usual, anomaly or trend wording.
